name: obsidian
description: Research Obsidian notes and review months with Linear task sources

interface.shortDescription: Research notes and review months with task references.
interface.longDescription: Searches and reads an explicitly selected Obsidian vault through the official CLI, then answers with precise note references while keeping the vault read-only. Monthly reviews combine Linear tasks and corresponding notes to provide source-backed moments and reflection prompts in chat, helping the user explore their feelings and what could make next month more enjoyable.
defaultPrompt: Obsidianのノートを調査し、参照元を示して回答してください。
先月のLinearタスクと対応するObsidianノートから、月の振り返りをチャットにまとめてください。
